description: Run one desktop product tool that the desktop marks bridgeRunnable (read-only queries, project verification, software simulation) — e.g. verify_iterx_project, get_project_issues, control_project_simulation. Tools that write files, flash or need user approval are refused (TOOL_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE) without running. Needs the desktop app; project tools open the project in a desktop window.

args.description: The tool arguments (its inputSchema from tool_list).

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

timeout.description: Wait limit, e.g. "120s" or "20m" (default 2 min; verify_iterx_project 20 min).

name: tool_run
